title: MSdev — AI wayfinding (AI_CONTEXT.md)
text: MSdev now focused LC-MS processing shell around MSdev S4 object: project orchestration, xcms-based feature processing, spectra handling, annotation glue, DDA/MRM utilities, network/flux wrappers, statistics, export/report helpers. Chemistry molecule-graph primitives refactored MSCC consumed .

title: MSdev — AI wayfinding (AI_CONTEXT.md)
text: Chemistry/structure modules (example CFM, RXN mapper, molecule graph classes/functions, related wrappers) migrated package. Local generic definitions graph accessors (vdata, vdata<-, edata, edata<-) removed MSdev.

title: MSdev — AI wayfinding (AI_CONTEXT.md)
text: MSdev still defines package-specific S4 classes workflows feature processing/analysis. MSdev provides methods Metabolic_flux_network rely imported MSCC graph generics.

title: MSdev — AI wayfinding (AI_CONTEXT.md)
text: MSCC defines exports graph generics/accessors. MSdev imports (including replace functions via raw namespace import) R/0_mscc_graph_generics_imports.R. Method registration Metabolic_flux_network accessors done .onLoad() R/0_mscc_graph_generics_imports.R avoid load-order issues.

title: MSdev — AI wayfinding (AI_CONTEXT.md)
text: Pipeline: get_xcms_feature_EIC_similarity → xcms_group_feature_EIC → MSdev_group_feature_EIC (per-polarity wrapper). Grouping uses groupSimilarityMatrix_completeLinkage (MsFeatures::groupSimilarityMatrix). Optional storage: otherData(xcms)$EIC_Similarity (per-sample sparse matrices). Report: Report_MSdev_feature_group_EIC writes Feature_group_EIC_Positive.pdf / Feature_group_EIC_Negative.pdf projectDir via plot_xcms_feature_group_EIC_comparasion. Shared helper .resolve_selected_sample lives (also used chromatogram extractors dev_xcms.R). Chromatograms reused xcmsData$Positive_Chromatograms / $Negative_Chromatograms (extract via MSdev_get_feature_chrom; retrieve via get_MSdev_Chromatogram(polarity=…) MSdev-function.R).

title: MSdev — AI wayfinding (AI_CONTEXT.md)
text: MSdev_extract_Spectra first-class: reads raw files, splits MS1/MS2, assigns sp_id, stores onDisk @spectra, calls MSdev_assign_MS2. Matching median-based (mzmed / rtmed + ppm / rt.tol), xcms::featureSpectra peak-box matching (get_Spectra_ms2_feature_id). MSdev_annotation / xcms_get_feature_ms2_score pull MS2 @spectra$MS2_Spectra via character ms2_id matched spectraNames. Helpers: get_MSdev_Spectra(msLevel=…, polarity=…), get_MSdev_Chromatogram(polarity=…), get_MSdev_spectra_target_list. Prefer direct @spectra / *_Chromatograms slot access. Old get_MSdev_ms1_Spectra / get_MSdev_ms2_Spectra removed. .update_MSdev_object migrates short-lived xcmsData$Positive / $Negative → PositiveMS1 / NegativeMS1 MS1-filters needed. Chromatogram keys stay Positive_Chromatograms / Negative_Chromatograms (retrieve get_MSdev_Chromatogram; polarity 0/1 → Negative/Positive). get_xcms_Spectra remains deprecated; prefer ProtGenerics::spectra() MS1 XcmsExperiment objects.

title: MSdev — AI wayfinding (AI_CONTEXT.md)
text: Read AI_CONTEXT.md first, open smallest domain file owns behavior. graph/generic issues, check R/0_mscc_graph_generics_imports.R NAMESPACE imports MSCC touching network files. Avoid broad edits large utility files (especially dev_xcms.R) unless caller boundaries clear. EIC feature-group work, edit R/MSdev-feature-group-EIC.R (logic) R/dev_plot.R (mirror plots) rather re-growing MSdev-function.R. architecture shifts (new migrations MSdev MSCC), update file explicit user request. Last refreshed unifying spectra/chromatogram getters: get_MSdev_Spectra(msLevel, polarity) get_MSdev_Chromatogram(polarity) replace get_MSdev_ms1_Spectra / get_MSdev_ms2_Spectra. file navigation aid, substitute reading source.

title: Get started with MSdev
text: Bioconductor dependencies xcms, Spectra, ProtGenerics must available. Install BiocManager::install() needed.
code: # remotes::install_github("DrRuiLi/MSdev") library(MSdev)

title: Get started with MSdev
text: Create directory raw files (.wiff, .raw, .mzML, .mzXML, …): Resume saved project:
code: object <- MSdev(rawDataDir = "path/to/rawDataDir") # optional: projectDir = "...", experimentInfo = MS_Exp() object <- MSdev_load("path/to/MSdev_YYYY_MM_DD.Rdata")

title: Get started with MSdev
text: Stock order used current project records: Optional features exist:
code: object <- MSdev("path/to/rawDataDir")  object <- MSdev_msConvert(object) object <- MSdev_checkSampleInfo(object)  object <- MSdev_set_param(   object,   findChromPeaks = xcms::CentWaveParam(ppm = 25, peakwidth = c(10, 60)),   groupChromPeaks = xcms::PeakDensityParam(     sampleGroups = "A", minFraction = 0.5, bw = 20, ppm = 25   ) )  object <- MSdev_xcmsProcessing(object) object <- MSdev_extract_Spectra(object)   # stores spectra + assigns MS2 to features  object <- MSdev_annotation(   object,   expand_adduct = TRUE,   cpdb_path = "path/to/CompoundDb.sqlite" )  object <- MSdev_get_Stat(object, score_thresh = 0.3) MSdev_export(object) MSdev_save(object) object <- MSdev_xcms_group_features(object)  # RT → abundance → EIC (xcms-style) object <- MSdev_group_feature_EIC(object)    # custom EIC similarity + stored matrices

title: Get started with MSdev
text: Prefer helpers digging slots: MS1 feature containers: Feature–MS2 links use character sp_id vectors featureDefinitions$ms2_id, matched MS2 spectraNames.
code: get_MSdev_Spectra(object, msLevel = 2, polarity = 1) get_MSdev_Chromatogram(object, polarity = 1) get_MSdev_spectra_target_list(object) object@xcmsData$PositiveMS1 object@xcmsData$NegativeMS1 # spectra on MS1 xcms objects: ProtGenerics::spectra(xcms)

title: Get started with MSdev
text: bundled demos available machine:
code: msdev.demo <- load_demo("MSdev") xcms.demo <- load_demo("xcms")       # alias for XcmsExperiment

title: Get started with MSdev
text: Related packages: MSCC (chemistry / graphs), xcms, Spectra.

title: MSdev untargeted workflow
text: New project raw-data directory: Resume saved object (skip create + earlier steps already done): practice use one entry point: create fresh study, load continuing.
code: library(MSdev)  object <- MSdev("path/to/rawDataDir") object <- MSdev_load("path/to/MSdev_YYYY_MM_DD.Rdata")

title: MSdev untargeted workflow
text: MSdev_msConvert() converts vendor raw files needed; inputs already .mzML / .mzXML, conversion skipped. MSdev_checkSampleInfo() validates sampleInfo (groups, polarity, msLevels, xcmsProcessing, etc.). Fix metadata interactively prompted.
code: object <- MSdev_msConvert(object) object <- MSdev_checkSampleInfo(object)

title: MSdev untargeted workflow
text: Tune peak picking correspondence processing (example values recent lipidomics run): Adjust ppm, peakwidth, bw, minFraction instrument chromatography. sampleGroups PeakDensityParam placeholder ; MSdev_xcmsProcessing() uses project sample groups runs.
code: object <- MSdev_set_param(   object,   findChromPeaks = xcms::CentWaveParam(     ppm = 25,     prefilter = c(3, 100),     peakwidth = c(10, 60),     snthresh = 10,     fitgauss = TRUE   ),   groupChromPeaks = xcms::PeakDensityParam(     sampleGroups = "A",     minFraction = 0.5,     binSize = 0.005,     bw = 20,     ppm = 25   ) )

title: MSdev untargeted workflow
text: MSdev_xcmsProcessing() runs peak picking / grouping (related xcms steps) polarity MS1 containers (PositiveMS1 / NegativeMS1). MSdev_extract_Spectra() loads MS1/MS2 @spectra, assigns sp_id, links MS2 features (MSdev_assign_MS2).
code: object <- MSdev_xcmsProcessing(object) object <- MSdev_extract_Spectra(object)

title: MSdev untargeted workflow
text: Example: LipidBlast SQLite common lipid adducts expanded adduct matching: Point cpdb_path CompoundDb SQLite used study. Change selected_adduct metabolomics vs lipidomics ion modes.
code: object <- MSdev_annotation(   object,   expand_adduct = TRUE,   cpdb_path = "path/to/CompoundDB/Lipidblast.sqlite",   selected_adduct = c(     "[M]+", "[M+NH4]+", "[M+H]+", "[M+Na]+",     "[M-H]-", "[M+HCOO]-", "[M+CH3COO]-"   ) )

title: MSdev untargeted workflow
text: score_thresh filters annotation scores building stats / metabolite tables. MSdev_export() writes tabular outputs project directory. MSdev_save() serializes MSdev object later MSdev_load().
code: object <- MSdev_get_Stat(object, score_thresh = 0.3) MSdev_export(object) MSdev_save(object)

title: MSdev untargeted workflow
text: Downstream plots use SummarizedExperiment annotated metabolites DEP helpers. Outputs go projectDir/Statistic/.
code: library(patchwork)  proj.dir <- object@projectInfo$projectDir data.se <- get_MSdev_DEP_se(object, from = "metabolite", QC_RSD = Inf)

title: MSdev untargeted workflow
code: p.pca <- DEP_plot_PCA(data.se) export_graph2pdf(   p.pca,   file.path(proj.dir, "Statistic", "Figures.pdf"),   width = 3, height = 3 )  p1 <- plot_xcms_TIC(object@xcmsData$PositiveMS1) +   labs(title = "Positive TIC") p2 <- plot_xcms_TIC(object@xcmsData$NegativeMS1) +   labs(title = "Negative TIC") p <- p1 + p2 + plot_layout(ncol = 1) export_graph2pdf(   p,   file.path(proj.dir, "Statistic", "Figures.pdf"),   width = 10, height = 8, append = TRUE )

title: MSdev untargeted workflow
text: non-Blank / non-QC sample.type, write: Statistic/<type>/Figures.pdf — volcano (unadjusted adjusted) + heatmap Statistic/<type>/diff.metabolites.xlsx — contrast tables Requires usable sample.type (contrast design) DEP SummarizedExperiment column data. Skip subset types needed exploratory runs (QC_RSD = Inf disables QC-RSD filtering example).
code: sample.types <- unique(as.character(data.se$sample.type)) sample.types <- sample.types[!is.na(sample.types) & nzchar(sample.types)] |>   setdiff(c("Blank", "QC"))  for (stype in sample.types) {   out.dir <- file.path(proj.dir, "Statistic", stype)   dir.create(out.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)   fig.pdf <- file.path(out.dir, "Figures.pdf")   diff.xlsx <- file.path(out.dir, "diff.metabolites.xlsx")    data.se1 <- data.se[, data.se$sample.type == stype]   data.se.p <- DEP_preprocess(data.se1)    # volcano without p-adjustment   data.diff <- DEP_test_diff(data.se.p, type = "all")   data.diff <- DEP_add_rejections(data.diff, p.adjust = FALSE)   p.diff <- ggplot_sum_patchwork(DEP_plot_volcano(data.diff, "all"))   export_graph2pdf(p.diff, fig.pdf, width = 10, height = 10)    # volcano with p-adjustment + export table   data.diff <- DEP_test_diff(data.se.p)   data.diff <- DEP_add_rejections(data.diff, p.adjust = TRUE)   p.diff <- ggplot_sum_patchwork(DEP_plot_volcano(data.diff, "all"))   export_graph2pdf(p.diff, fig.pdf, width = 10, height = 10, append = TRUE)   table.diff <- DEP_get_diff_table(data.diff, contrast = "all", keep.all = TRUE)   xlsx.write.list(table.diff, diff.xlsx)    # significant features heatmap   data.diff <- DEP_test_diff(data.se.p, type = "all")   data.diff <- DEP_add_rejections(data.diff, p.adjust = FALSE)   data.hm <- DEP_filter_significant(data.diff)   hm <- DEP_plot_heatmap(data.hm)   export_graph2pdf(hm, fig.pdf, width = 10, height = 20, append = TRUE) }

title: MSdev untargeted workflow
text: See also articles Spectra backends, chromatogram extraction, EicSimilarityParam feature grouping.

title: Rdisop mass decomposition (`decomposeMass`)
text: Decide explicitly whether input ion m/z neutral mass. mix “neutral mass + z = 1” unless intentional.

title: Rdisop mass decomposition (`decomposeMass`)
text: Rdisop’s z full ESI charge-state converter. Empirical check (mass = 203.0526, CHNO, 5 ppm): Correct pre-conversion calling decomposeMass (bare charge / electron correction; adducts still separate): Msearch=m/z×|z|±z⋅M_{\text{search}} = m/z \times |z| \;\pm\; z \cdot m_e m/z = 203.0526, z = 2 must decompose ~406.1 Da, 203 101.5. 101.5 getMolecule(..., z = 2) reports ~203 Da formula (output m/z). 406 mass scale 2+ ion whose observed m/z 203. MassTools::calcMF mz + z * m_e calls decomposeMass — also multiply |z|, gap |z|>1|z| > 1. Rule formula calculator: convert m/z → search mass (mz * |z| ± z*/adduct correction via MSCC), call decomposeMass(..., z = 0) (z = ±1 intentionally want ion-parity semantics already-converted mass). MSdev / MSCC split:

title: Feature grouping with `EicSimilarityParam`
